comparison.objective: Aim a registered inspection camera at a target while preserving its pivot datum.
comparison.physical_skill: Coupled adjustment of two passive controls with datum-preserving force application; no striking, fracture, or loose-part containment.
comparison.success_condition: Settled camera axis must intersect the target, pivot must remain registered throughout, and both hands must be clear. Numeric aim, datum, clearance, and settling thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests kinematic aiming under registration constraints rather than destructive notch completion and recovery of released fragments.
